name: discussion-vocabulary-diagnosis
description: Diagnose vocabulary in the Discussion of an English psychology research paper. Checks (1) use of academic register and high-frequency academic expressions, (2) appropriate modal verb usage, (3) hedging variety and precision, and (4) avoidance of colloquialisms.
author: UX Course Project - Discussion Group

clawhub.theory_basis: Glasman-Deal (2021) Science Research Writing Unit 4.4 (academic register) + 4.5 (modal verbs)
